answer: Agents earn voting weight only after locking scarce tokens in a public bond that can be slashed when independent audits expose coordinated duplicate identities. The protocol samples claims against signed activity histories, so a Sybil cluster must either behave consistently enough to be linked or risk losing its stake. A whisper from one account cannot cheaply become a chorus: each added persona requires more capital, and evasion risks the jade and onyx bonds alike.
